rust.name: src/commands/use_.rs:64:28: replace match guard record.role[i].source != found.source with false in <impl Command for Args>::run
rust.why: Repeated installs use the same source, leaving a same-named role from a second source untested.

rust.name: src/project.rs:248:24: replace match guard known.url != entry.url with false in locate
rust.why: Sync tests cover a matching source URL and a missing source, leaving a configured source with a conflicting URL untested.

rust.name: src/project.rs:87:38: replace || with && in Record::load
rust.why: The tests load valid SHAs, so they miss a record slipping through with a short hexadecimal revision.

rust.name: src/project.rs:164:30: delete ! in sync
rust.why: The deletion test retains the core skill, so it misses a stale manifest when sync removes the final generated file.

rust.name: src/project.rs:362:26: replace || with && in remove_empty_parents
rust.why: Other skills keep the target directory populated in the deletion test, masking whether cleanup respects an empty target directory.
